name: CoD2 Silicon 0.2 beta
body:
## Highlights

- **Launcher redesign** with [Liquid Glass](https://developer.apple.com/design/) navigation.
- Server browser favourites.

## Install
Unzip it.

Fixes `r_mode` on 6K displays and keeps raw mouse input on after alt-tab. This sentence is long enough to need trimming because it keeps going with more and more detail about every small change in the release, far beyond the dispatch length.

name: CoD2 Silicon 0.1.0
body:
